title: sayeria mooreana
intro: Sayeria mooreana, commonly known as the Queensland Nut, is a plant species native to Australia. The plant has been used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Sayeria mooreana include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents of the plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
